title: DeepResearch Bench II: Diagnosing Deep Research Agents via Rubrics from Expert Report

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (relative scores) on deep research tasks in English versus Chinese using one-way ANOVA tests to determine if systems exhibit sensitivity to language variation.
Evaluating model performance variations across different research domains (e.g., Health, Finance & Business, Software Development) using one-way ANOVA tests to control for inherent task difficulty.
